help.text:
elm327 — live OBD-II dashboard for ELM327 adapters

Usage
  npx elm327                         interactive setup (recommended)
  npx elm327 --demo                  simulated vehicle (asks what the flags did not say)
  npx elm327 --serial /dev/ttyUSB0   USB / paired Bluetooth serial adapter
  npx elm327 --wifi 192.168.0.10     WiFi adapter (default port 35000)

Options
  --demo, --simulate       use the built-in vehicle simulator
  --serial <path>          serial device (COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.OBDII-...)
  --baud <rate>            serial baud rate (default 38400)
  --wifi <host[:port]>     WiFi adapter address
  --pids <set>             essentials | fuel | temperatures | emissions | all | NAME,NAME
  --interval <ms>          polling interval (default {interval})
  --json <file>            write a JSON session report on exit
  --log <file>             write a log file (see --log-format, --log-level, --log-max-lines)
  --log-format <fmt>       pretty | json | raw (default pretty)
  --log-level <detail>     errors | traffic | all (default traffic)
  --log-max-lines <n>      rotate the log after n lines, 0 = never (default 100000)
  --compat <mode>          adapter compatibility: auto | strict | lenient | minimal
  --sim-errors <rate>      simulator: share of requests that fail, 0 to 1
  --sim-dtc <codes|none>   simulator: stored trouble codes, e.g. P0301,P0420
  --no-dtc                 do not read trouble codes
  --no-reconnect           do not reconnect automatically
  --lang <code>            interface language: {languages}
  --web                    show the dashboard in your browser instead of the terminal
  --terminal               show the dashboard in the terminal (default)
  --port <n>               web dashboard port (default 3327)
  --host <address>         web dashboard address (default 127.0.0.1; 0.0.0.0 exposes it to your network)
  --no-open                do not open the browser automatically
  --list-ports             list serial ports and exit
  --once                   print one dashboard frame and exit
  -y, --yes                skip every question and use defaults
  -v, --version            print the version
  -h, --help               show this help

Keys
  q quit · p pause · ←/→ choose chart signal · +/- polling rate
  d read codes · c clear codes · l toggle traffic · r reset adapter · s save report

With the connection, view, signals and interval on the command line, no questions are asked.
